declarations.name: HonuaMeasurementElement
declarations.description: Distance and area measurement drawn directly on a MapLibre map.

members.name: addVertex
members.description: Adds a vertex programmatically (same as a map click). Returns `false`, changing nothing, when no mode is active or the position is not a usable WGS84 vertex (non-finite, or latitude outside `[-90, 90]`).

members.name: areaUnit
members.description: Displayed area unit. `"auto"` (default) keeps the metric auto-scaling behavior. Changing this reformats the existing full-precision result — it never recomputes from a rounded display value.

members.name: cancel
members.description: Cancels the in-progress sketch (same as Escape); the mode stays active.

members.name: connect
members.description: Wires the widget to a MapLibre map. Equivalent to setting `.map`.

members.name: crs
members.description: CRS vertices are recorded in. Always WGS84 (`"EPSG:4326"`): vertices come from map click events, which report geographic lng/lat regardless of the map's own projection. Exposed so a consumer never has to assume it.

members.name: fidelity
members.description: Which math computes `result.distance` / `result.area`: `"geodesic"` (default, great-circle over WGS84) or `"planar"` (Euclidean, in the `planarCrs` frame — see `./measurement-units.js`). Changing this recomputes from the drawn vertices, since it changes which math produces the canonical value.

members.name: finish
members.description: Finishes the in-progress sketch (same as double-click).

members.name: map
members.description: The MapLibre map this widget draws on.

members.name: messages
members.description: Caller-supplied labels, statuses, and ARIA text; unset entries keep the English defaults.

members.name: planarCrs
members.description: Planar frame used when `fidelity` is `"planar"`: `"local"` (default, flat-earth meters around the sketch) or `"EPSG:3857"` (Web Mercator meters, not scale-corrected). Recomputes like `fidelity` does.

members.name: precision
members.description: Decimal digits for the displayed value. `undefined` (default) uses a per-unit default.

members.name: result
members.description: The current (or last finished) measurement result.

members.name: setMode
members.description: Activates a measure mode; `"off"` cancels any in-progress sketch.

members.name: unit
members.description: Displayed distance unit. `"auto"` (default) keeps the metric auto-scaling behavior. Changing this reformats the existing full-precision result — it never recomputes from a rounded display value.

members.name: vertices
members.description: The in-progress vertex list (`[lng, lat]` positions).

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: `id` of the `<honua-map>` (or any element exposing `.map`) to measure on.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Heading and accessible name of the panel; `messages.label` wins when set.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Displayed distance unit. `"auto"` (default) keeps the metric auto-scaling behavior. Changing this reformats the existing full-precision result — it never recomputes from a rounded display value.

attributes.name: area-unit

Changing this recomputes from the drawn vertices, since it changes which math produces the canonical value.

events.name: honua-measure-change
events.description: A mode, vertex, result, fidelity, or planar CRS change. Bubbles and is composed.
